title: changes
description: What a write answers when it has no answer of its own: every file it touched. delete, link, unlink, vocabulary, design create, move, delete, purpose and storage answer this, so one reader reads them all.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Changes, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: One entry per file the write touched, in the order the files were first touched; empty when nothing was written. A refusal that changed nothing has an empty list, and a write that failed halfway still lists what it changed.
